title: Y Combinator — batch applications
description: Three month programme in the San Francisco Bay Area. Standard deal is 125,000 US dollars for 7 per cent, plus an uncapped note on a most favoured nation basis. Two batches a year, applications open ahead of each.

title: Techstars Accelerator — global programmes
description: Thirteen week mentorship-driven accelerator running across dozens of cities and verticals. Investment of 20,000 US dollars for 5 per cent common stock plus an optional 100,000 dollar convertible note.

title: Antler Residency — pre-team, pre-idea programme
description: Day-zero programme for founders without a co-founder or a fixed idea. Runs in more than twenty cities. Typical investment is around 100,000 US dollars for high single digit equity at the end of the residency.

title: 500 Global Flagship Accelerator
description: Four month seed-stage accelerator focused on growth and distribution, run out of the San Francisco Bay Area with regional funds elsewhere.

title: Google for Startups Accelerator — Africa
description: Equity-free three month programme for seed to Series A African startups using technology to solve local problems. Includes Google Cloud credits, mentorship and technical support.

title: Microsoft for Startups Founders Hub
description: Self-serve programme granting Azure and OpenAI credits, developer tooling and technical advisory. No equity taken and no referral required to join.

title: Ventures Platform — pre-seed and seed investment
description: Pan-African early stage fund investing at pre-seed and seed in fintech, health, education, logistics and enabling infrastructure. Applications accepted on a rolling basis.

title: Future Africa — founder applications
description: Early stage fund and syndicate backing African startups turning problems into prosperity. Open founder application with a collective of angel investors alongside the fund.

title: a16z Speedrun — twelve week programme
description: Programme for startups at the intersection of technology and consumer products, including games, AI and entertainment. Investment of up to 1 million US dollars per company.

title: Entrepreneur First — talent investor programme
description: Invests in individuals before they have a company or co-founder, then supports team formation and a first round. Cohorts in London, Bangalore, New York, Paris and Singapore.

title: Seedcamp — pre-seed and seed applications
description: European first-cheque fund investing at pre-seed and seed with an open rolling application and no fixed cohort.

title: AfriLabs — funding and capacity programmes
description: Network of African innovation hubs running recurring grant, funding and capacity building calls for startups and hubs across the continent.
